definition: Maximizing the share of AI requests that succeed with acceptable quality within cost, latency and compute budgets.
details: Like manufacturing yield, the goal is fewer defective or wasted runs. Teams tune prompts, routing, retries, model choice and inference settings so more requests meet quality thresholds without overspending.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. The machine starts out clumsy, makes mistakes, and is nudged a little less wrong every time. It is the same loop you use to learn anything: try, miss, correct, try again. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Yield Optimization.
